AI models can have billions — even trillions — of parameters. But what does that actually mean? They aren’t facts. They aren’t memories. And they definitely aren’t billions of lines of code. Parameters are the learned numbers that control how a neural network transforms information — tiny weights and biases, repeated across an enormous mathematical system. Prof. Whitaker breaks down what a “parameter” actually is, starting with a single artificial neuron and scaling all the way up to modern LLMs. Once you understand this, model sizes like 7B, 70B, or 1T parameters finally start to make sense. #AI #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #LLM #NeuralNetworks

If you’re searching for the best AI apps and tools for 2026, don’t just ask which individual AI app is the most powerful. The bigger question is: Which AI tools can work together? We’ve moved far beyond opening ChatGPT or Claude, asking a question and copying the answer into another app. The most powerful AI tools can now connect to the platforms where the work actually happens. That means less copying, pasting, reformatting and switching between tabs—and more complete workflows with far less friction. Here are five AI apps you need to try together: ChatGPT + Lovable can help you build an app with AI. Describe the website or app you want, then use ChatGPT and Lovable to develop the pages, copy, workflows, authentication and security checks. This is one of my favorite AI app ideas because it turns a conversation into something people can actually use. ChatGPT + Canva connects AI prompting with visual creation. ChatGPT can develop the concept, structure and messaging. Canva can turn those ideas into branded presentations, graphics, marketing materials and social content. For anyone researching AI content tools, AI marketing or AI for creators, this combination can remove a huge amount of friction between having an idea and publishing it. Claude + Blotato turns content creation into content distribution. Claude can research, write and adapt your message. Blotato can help create, schedule and publish that content across multiple social platforms. If you’re comparing the best AI tools for TikTok, AI video tools or AI UGC tools, don’t only evaluate what can generate content. Look for combinations that can also help move that content through the rest of the workflow. Claude + QuickBooks helps turn financial information into understandable answers. Instead of staring at complicated reports, you can ask questions in plain language, explore what the numbers mean and identify clearer next steps for your business. ChatGPT + GoHighLevel connects AI with your leads, opportunities, appointments and customer conversations. ChatGPT can help you understand what is happening inside your pipeline, identify where follow-up is needed and make your AI marketing workflows more useful. This is the real shift in AI tools for 2026: Individual AI apps give us answers. Connected AI apps help us accomplish the work. The technology behind many of these connections is called MCP, or Model Context Protocol. Think of it as a bridge that allows an AI assistant to work with the apps and information you already use. The best AI tools aren’t necessarily the ones with the longest feature lists. They’re the AI tools that save you hours by removing the space between deciding, creating and executing. Stop building a collection of disconnected AI apps. Start building combinations that move your work forward.
